import csv, collections
meter='c889cadf-ee1a-5783-816a-c60c58430141'
data=collections.defaultdict(dict)
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        if r['timeseries_id']==meter and r['timestamp'].startswith('2018-10'):
            data[r['timestamp'][:10]][r['timestamp'][11:13]]=float(r['value'])
days=sorted(data)
print("num days", len(days))
# all 24-hour dates
def hourlyvals(d):
    v=data[d]
    return [v.get(f"{h:02d}") for h in range(24)]
daily={}
prev_day=days[0]
for i,d in enumerate(days):
    hv=hourlyvals(d)
    if all(x is not None for x in hv):
        end=hv[-1]
        if i>0:
            pv=hourlyvals(days[i-1])
            prev_end=pv[-1]
            if prev_end is not None:
                daily[d]=end-prev_end
print("daily count", len(daily))
print(list(daily.items())[:3])
vals=list(daily.values())
mean=sum(vals)/len(vals)
print("mean", mean)
over=[d for d,v in daily.items() if v>1.10*mean]
print(over)
print(len(over))
